hook.line: The hottest job in AI can pay you $500K to a million dollars.
hook.visual: Top half: photo of a tech executive in an office with a navy banner 'This AI role pays $500K' and a US flag; bottom half: creator talking to camera.

beats.what: Salary claim: executive photo with a big $500K banner over the talking head
Cut to full-frame face; the role name 'FDE' appears as an italic title card
Full navy graphic 'Make AI work': three numbered steps (model, customer workflow, working solution), face shrunk to a circle bubble
Title text 'Solve the problem.' over the face while he lists the skills
Five-step list starts: '01 Claude API' header with a screenshot of the free course page above the face
Step 02 'Agentic AI': course syllabus screenshot, face again in a circle
Step 03 'Hugging Face': screenshot of the agents course with its mascot
Step 04 'Cloud certification': screenshot of a cloud certification page
Step 05 title 'One real agent.' over the face: build and deploy one real project
CTA card 'Comment GUIDE' in large serif type over the face

why_it_works: A dollar figure in the first frame, with a photo of a famous-looking executive, gives an instant reason to stay
A numbered five-step list ('01'-'04' headers) tells the viewer how much is left, so they wait for the last step
Each step gets a real screenshot of the course page, which makes free resources feel concrete and worth saving
Comment-keyword CTA ('GUIDE') turns the list into a lead magnet and drives comments (480) and shares (1022)
weaknesses: The executive photo implies an endorsement the video never explains
Talking head is static at the same framing throughout; the energy comes only from the graphics
Small screenshot text is unreadable at phone size and only works as decoration
for_robert: Use a numbered step header ('01', '02'...) in a fixed top slot and let Fred hold up or point at each number as it changes, so the list structure is visible without extra text.
